body.rule: Among independent conflicting candidate observations for the same field, prefer the higher authority_class; a same-authority-class conflict is never resolved by averaging and is reported as unresolved_blocking or unresolved_diagnostic per materiality.
An observation with information_available_at strictly after the governed cutoff_instant is never eligible for selection, regardless of authority or freshness.
Freshness state (fresh/acceptable/stale/expired/unknown) is classified per observation kind against T04-owned threshold tables, pinned by version; thresholds themselves are not redefined here.
Prefer a direct quoted rate; if unavailable, use its exact inverse; a triangulated path through exactly one pivot currency is allowed only when neither a direct nor inverse quote is available.
A selection may only be overridden by explicit, authored, provenance-preserving metadata; an override's rationale and original candidate are never discarded.
Prefer the official close for the most recent eligible session; if unavailable, fall back to the most recent prior eligible close under the cutoff. No averaging across sessions or sources.
Basis is spot_basic_shares_outstanding, reconciled from issued_shares minus treasury_shares as of the same effective date as the selected price observation.
